about_the_game:
Embark on a quest to stop your phone from ringing all the time in Lost Call, a top down Adventure inspired by classic 2D Zelda games and Metroidvanias. In order to disable all nearby cell towers, you will find yourself traveling through many distinct areas, fighting strange and fearsome creatures, and making use of ordinary household objects in order to reach your goal of some peace and quiet.

Explore and uncover your own path

  • Find your own unique route through a vast open map, with many possible paths

  • Unlock shortcuts, uncover secrets, and find new areas in unexpected places

  • Collect abilities to reach new areas, and find helpful upgrades

Master unconventional means of combat and movement

  • Collect items with more than one use, assisting both with fights and travel

  • Ring your phone and fling hair elastics to deal damage, and push enemies around with a hair dryer

Meet friendly characters and discover your own story

  • Uncover memories from your past, and collect your discarded poetry

  • Meet a wide range of characters, left behind in a broken town

  • Attempt to solve the mystery of a missing explorer by searching for tape recordings

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 @ 3.2 GHZ
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX9
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Lost Call is a top down pixel art 2D Zelda inspired game with a metroidvania style map. Take off on a quest through an abandoned and ruined town to stop your phone from ringing all the time, and learn more about the characters who still remain within it.
